Do you enjoy working with colleagues and are you looking for a logistics job with long-term career opportunities? At CEVA Logistics in Waalwijk, you will work as an Order Picker. Together with your team, you will make sure orders are processed accurately and on time. You will work in a modern warehouse where teamwork, a positive work atmosphere, and quality are important. You will also have the opportunity to develop your skills through training courses. Does this sound like the right job for you? Apply today!

Your tasks may include:

    - Picking orders using a scanner
    
- Inspecting products and returned goods
    
- Processing and registering goods in the system
    
- Preparing orders for shipment
    
- Working together with colleagues to achieve daily targets
    
- Following work instructions and quality procedures

What’s in it for you

    - Gross hourly wage of €14.99
    
- Travel allowance according to the client's reimbursement scheme
    
- Full-time employment
    
- Temporary employment contract with the possibility of being hired directly by the client based on good performance
    
- A long-term position with growth opportunities
    
- Pension accrual through Manpower
    
- Free access to more than 200 online training courses via the Manpower Academy
    
- An international working environment with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and a great team atmosphere

    - Good command of the English language, both spoken and written
    
- Basic skills in working with computers or tablets
    
- Ability to spend most of the working day standing
    
- Availability for a full-time position (40 hours per week)

Would you like to start working as an Order Picker at CEVA Logistics in Waalwijk? Apply today and find out if this position is the right fit for you. Together with your colleagues, you will make sure orders are processed correctly and on time. We look forward to receiving your application!

Do you like hands-on work and want a job with plenty of variety? As a Safety Mask Technician, you play a key role in keeping workers safe on and around the Tata Steel site.

You do not need prior technical experience or qualifications: we teach you everything on the job. Both English and Dutch speakers are welcome to apply!

What you will be doing

In this active role, you make sure safety masks and breathing equipment are clean, fully functioning, and 100% safe to use.

- Cleaning & testing: Disassemble masks and equipment, clean them thoroughly, reassemble them, and test their safety.
- Driving on-site: Drive a car or van across the Tata Steel site to collect and deliver equipment for your team.
- Digital registration: Log tested and certified equipment in the computer system.
- Work schedule: Work 32 to 40 hours per week in fixed 2-shift schedules (06:00 - 14:00 and 14:00 - 22:00).

🚗 Important: Public transport does not run during these early and late shift times. You must have your own transport (car, motorbike, or scooter).

- Driving license: Valid category B driving license (required for driving on-site).
- Transport: Own transport (car, motorbike, or scooter) to reach IJmuiden.
- Languages: Good command of English OR Dutch.
- Experience: No diploma or previous experience required.
- Availability: Willing to work 2-shift schedules (06:00 - 14:00 and 14:00 - 22:00).

A fulltime job in a cookie factory? Yummm! 🍪 You get a salary of €16,37 and Allowances up to 39% in the evening. Earn up to €24,55 per hour! Perfect, right?! And you have the chance to get a permanent contract with fixed hours within a year! It’s possible as a production employee at Merba in Oosterhout (NB)!

-  A salary of €16,37 bruto each hour (18+)
-  Get up to €24,55 with shift allowances!

You love cookies of course! To keep the factory running, it is important that you meet the following requirements as a production employee:

🕑 14:00 - 22:00

You will work in the heart of the dynamic flower auction environment, where no two days are the same. Together with your colleagues, you will be responsible for assembling and preparing transport carts. This is a part-time position with some flexibility and offers a long-term opportunity to learn the trade through hands-on experience. Your day begins by checking orders and gathering the materials needed to build the carts. You will work closely with your team to ensure that all carts are completed and ready for transport on time. You maintain a clear overview, work accurately, and help keep the workplace clean and organized. In addition, you assist in resolving any bottlenecks to ensure the logistics process runs smoothly. The standard working days are Monday and Friday, with working hours to be agreed upon. There is also the possibility of additional hours during peak periods. 

- Minimum VMBO level of work and thinking
- Good command of spoken and written English and/or Dutch
- Physically capable of performing standing and walking work throughout the day
- Living within a maximum distance of 30 km from Aalsmeer

As an Orderpicker, you’ll work in a fast-paced environment, enjoy great benefits, and have opportunities to grow. Start your logistics career in Almere today. Good work!Over de functieYou will play a key role in making sure supermarket products reach customers on time. The workplace in Almere is a modern warehouse where efficiency and teamwork are highly valued. You can expect a friendly vibe, with team members supporting each other and a buddy system in place to help new colleagues get started. In the canteen, you’ll find free fruit and a warm meal during afternoon shifts, plus a coffee and tea station to keep you energized. If you enjoy an active job and being part of a supportive team, this is the place for you.

- Available for at least 32 hours per week, including Saturdays
- Willing to work in both cold and warm areas and switch departments as needed
- Punctual, reliable, and a good team player
- No previous experience needed, but similar roles like ware

Do you want to use and further develop your technical skills? As a cnc operator, you get the chance to work with the most modern machines in the production of high-tech parts. You work full-time, during the day, in an innovative environment where your development is key. You’ll have plenty of opportunities for training and to grow within the company. This position is for the long term, so you’re really helping to build the future!
You start your working day by setting up and operating cnc machines, including 5-axis milling, wire EDM, and precision grinding. You read technical drawings, prepare the machines, and check if all parts meet the highest quality standards. You immediately notice if something needs adjusting, think along with the programmers, and do daily minor maintenance. This way, you and your colleagues ensure a safe, tidy workplace and continuously improve the production process.
Does it sound exciting to work with the latest technologies and be a key player in production? Do you want to learn, grow, and really make an impact in technology? Apply now for this cnc operator position and discover how you can make a difference!

- 

- You have mbo-level education or comparable technical experience

- You have experience with cnc machining (milling, grinding, or drilling is a plus)

- You can read and understand technical drawings

- You work accurately and have an eye for quality

- You speak and write English well

Come and work as a packing employee at Leerdam Crisal Glass in Gorinchem. 🥳 You will earn a great hourly wage of € 14,99 per hour (+21)! You will also be surrounded by a team of enthusiastic colleagues. Apply now and start working as a packing employee at LCG Gorinchem! ✨

What will you do
Will you ensure that Ikea receives a new shipment of drinking glasses? The glasses are produced at the factory in Leerdam. They are then transported to the warehouse in Gorinchem. 📦 As a packing employee you are the one who packs the glasses into boxes using special instructions. You then stack them neatly on pallets. This way, the glasses are ready for your colleague on the forklift to pick them up. And thanks to your fast work, we can send them to IKEA on time. Now that's teamwork! ✨

Where will you work
As a packing employee at the LCG distribution center, you will be part of a super fun and diverse team. Young, old, different cultures—everyone is included! 💛 You never work alone, but always with 1 to 3 friendly colleagues. That makes the work not only fun, but also nice and smooth. Production Worker (Early Shift)  As a Production Worker in the egg breaking department, you are responsible for operating and monitoring the machines that process eggs. You start your workday early in the morning at 05:00 by preparing the production line and setting up the machinery. Throughout the shift, you monitor the automated process that breaks eggs and separates egg whites from yolks, while performing quality and hygiene checks. At the end of the shift, you thoroughly clean the equipment and work environment together with your team, ensuring everything is ready for the next day.
 This is a position through Staffice at our client, with the prospect of a permanent contract after 3 months of full-time work!

 -  Checking the quality and separation of egg whites and egg yolks
 
 -  Conducting regular visual quality and hygiene inspections during production
 
 -  Cleaning and sanitizing production equipment and the work environment after production
 
 -  Working efficiently alongside team members to ensure all daily batches are processed
 
 
 Requirements  -  Great motivation, reliability, and a positive work attitude
 
 -  Availability to start work early in the morning at 05:00
 
 -  Willingness to work occasionally on Saturdays according to the team schedule

Stegeman is looking for you! Cleaning HERO for our Sanitary Team in Wijhe! 🫧
Are you a careful and reliable person who knows how important hygiene is? Do you look closely at details and want a key job in our production? 👀 Then we have THE best full-time job for you at Stegeman in Wijhe as an industrial cleaner! 💡

What we offer
- Salary of €20,08 per hour during the night shift!
- Start full-time right away.
- Chance to get a permanent contract! 😎
- Get paid for travel: €0.23 cents per kilometer!
- Grow your career: Become the new Operator!
- Work in a nice and close team.

Who you are
For this industrial cleaner job, it would be great if you already have some cleaning experience. Also, the following is important:

- You are ready to work night shifts;
- You live near Wijhe;
- You speak Dutch or English;
- You have your own car or transport to get to Wijhe.

What will you do
As an industrial cleaner, you are the main person who makes sure every production day starts perfectly. Your job is very important for clean working and moving things around. 🔑 Your main work is to clean the production areas and machines. You will use a medium-pressure sprayer to do this quickly and correctly. The meat must be fully removed, so the machines are ready for fresh meat the next day. Being accurate is key for food safety! You will also help with transport tasks and other logistical work to support the production.

In the night shift 🌙, which you do every other week, from 22:40 to 05:10, you focus on getting things ready. You are also in charge of setting up new machines. In the weeks you do not have the night shift, you will work in the processing department, also cleaning machines as our industrial cleaner.
